description: This file defines the 'RequestException' class within the GuzzleHttp library, specifically handling HTTP request-related exceptions. It includes methods for wrapping, creating, and retrieving information about exceptions that occur during HTTP requests.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request exception, capturing details about the request, response, and context, and providing factory methods for instantiation.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a non-RequestException throwable into a RequestException instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException instance with a normalized error message, based on the response status or error context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request object that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response object associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether a response was received for the request.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns the array of contextual information from the underlying handler.
